oneLine: Fredun Pharmaceuticals acquired a 26% stake in Goodman Vetcare for ₹300 Crore.

sources.title: Fredun Pharmaceuticals Acquires 26% Stake In Goodman Vetcare Worth ₹300 Crore

synopsis: Fredun Pharmaceuticals has acquired a 26% equity stake in pet-care retailer Goodman Vetcare Private Limited, in a transaction valuing the retailer at approximately ₹300 crore. The strategic partnership aims to scale Goodman Vetcare's retail footprint from a three-store network in Mumbai to an eleven-store chain across three cities, targeting an annual revenue of ~₹40 crore by FY27 and ~₹100 crore by FY31. Goodman Vetcare grew its revenue from ₹14.1 crore in FY24 to ₹23.6 crore in FY26 without prior institutional backing. The acquisition allows Fredun Pharmaceuticals to establish a direct-to-consumer retail presence to verticalize its veterinary product segment, Freossi, utilizing Goodman's retail network as a captive channel for product testing and consumer feedback.
